title: Program resource bounds
statement: Let $n,r$ be nonnegative integers, let the target be a Boolean function on the sign cube, and let the seed map send Boolean strings of length $r$ to the binary cube of dimension $n$. Every outcome in the support of the program’s run distribution uses zero random examples, exactly three membership queries, and exactly $n+r+(2n+1)+3$ units of local work.
hypotheses_covered: target is a Boolean function on the sign cube
seed map has the stated domain and codomain
outcome belongs to the support of the program's run distribution
